questions: Which advanced lints does CI miss?
How does speculative telemetry reach the CLI status?

findings.detail: 14 clippy lints in non-gguf advanced files (quantize x10, flash_attn_gpu:114, multi_gpu:44, simd_tokenizer_v2:323, speculative_config:21); advanced absent from rust.yml matrix.

F2 mod.rs comments accurate/grep-clean; F3 standalone test absent; THREAT_MODEL §12.2 is PHANTOM (doc has s1-8). Speculation adds no path surface (register_draft_pair takes ids; loader enforces allowlist).

build_status is IPC client (no engine); record_speculative_cycle Prometheus counters dormant (no caller); executor feeds in-process SpeculativeTelemetry only. Fix = executor->Prometheus + metrics-derived stats (partial).
